name: beyond_create_project
description: Create a new Platform project in an organization, clone its repository into the user's workspace, and set it as the active checked-out Platform project. If organization_id is omitted, the server falls back to the user's default organization (user_id_org when available, otherwise the first linked organization).For project setup with supplied requirements (Excel/docs/chat), do not stop at acknowledgement: check existing BE records, save traceable DRAFT requirements within the requested scope, verify saved IDs, then ask focused gap questions. Reuse prior agreement and answered questions. Reading/summarizing alone does not authorize writes. Without supplied requirements, offer an interview. Applicable intake and next-stage guides are inline. ALWAYS save BE ANALYSIS_CONTENT as Markdown.

organization_id.description: Organization where the project will be created. Prefer one of the organization_id values returned by beyond_get_my_organizations with can_create_project=true; never use placeholder values such as 'default'. If omitted, the server uses the user's default organization, marked by is_default=true when listed.

examples.project_description: Design workspace for delivery business data and APIs

active_context.description: Current checked-out project context after the project has been created, cloned, and activated.
